name: GPT-Live 1.1

voice.input_audio: WebSocket: mono signed PCM16 at 24 kHz (default) or 16 kHz, or G.711 μ-law or A-law at 8 kHz. WebRTC and SIP negotiate audio format [openai-live-websockets] [openai-live-reference]
voice.output_audio: WebSocket uses the same format as input. WebRTC delivers output through the media track. Live sends input and output transcript fragments as events [openai-live-websockets] [openai-live-sessions]
voice.voices: Set audio.output.voice at startup. Default marin. The sessions guide lists built-in voices by language and regional influence. It permits authorized custom voices. The TypeScript reference lists fewer built-in names [openai-live-sessions] [openai-live-reference] [openai-custom-voices]
voice.turn_detection: The full-duplex model manages conversational timing. For WebRTC standby, wake_policy.vad_threshold sets speech sensitivity from 0 to 1 (default 0.5), independent of active turn detection [openai-live-model] [openai-live-prompting] [openai-live-sessions] [openai-live-reference]
voice.interruption: The prompting guide tells the voice model to yield when the caller interrupts. Application task state controls backend cancellation [openai-live-prompting] [openai-live-delegation]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: US$0.05/min active and US$0.02/min on WebRTC standby, accrued per second. Default WebRTC startup bills 15 seconds up front, credited against running duration. Backend model and tool charges are separate [openai-live-pricing] [openai-live-cost]

unknown: max_output: OpenAI lists no voice-model output-token cap [openai-live-model]
voice.languages: named presets and launch examples cover several languages, but the sources read give no complete model language list [openai-live-sessions] [openai-chatgpt-notes]
voice.latency: no numerical GPT-Live-1.1 figure found in OpenAI’s release or model page, or in the Artificial Analysis speech results [openai-live-release] [openai-live-model] [aa-speech-to-speech]
voice.session_limit: the sessions guide defines the expired close reason without giving a duration [openai-live-sessions]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: voice billing is by duration [openai-live-pricing]
